buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC)

Supply, Installation and Commissioning of 10 Desktop Computers Purchaser: Government Commercial Institute, Mannanthala, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. 1. Installation and Commissioning: The successful bidder shall supply, install, configure and commission all 10 desktop computers at Government Commercial Institute, Mannanthala, at no additional cost to the pur chaser. 2. Payment Terms: Payment shall be processed only after the successful delivery, installation, commissioni ng, testing and satisfactory acceptance of all 10 desktop computers by the purchaser, subject to the applic able GeM General Terms and Conditions and payment provisions. 3. On-site Warranty: The supplied desktop computers shall carry a comprehensive on-site warranty as spe cified in the bid. The warranty shall cover all hardware components, including the processor, motherboard, RAM, SSD/HDD, SMPS, monitor and other supplied components. 4. Service Centre in Kerala: The bidder/OEM must have an authorised service centre in Kerala. The bidder shall provide the complete address, contact number and details of the authorised service centre along wit h the bid. 5. On-site Service Support: During the warranty period, all repair and maintenance services shall be provid ed at the premises of Government Commercial Institute, Mannanthala. The bidder shall arrange for qualifie d service personnel to visit the institution whenever required. The purchaser shall not be required to trans port defective computers to the service centre. 6. Warranty Service Charges: All expenses towards service visits, labour charges, spare parts, replacemen t of defective components and other warranty-related services shall be borne entirely by the bidder/OEM. No additional payment shall be claimed from the purchaser during the warranty period. 7. Service Response Time: The bidder shall respond to service complaints within 48 hours and arrange on- site technical support within a reasonable time. The defect shall be rectified within 7 working days, wherev er technically feasible. 8. Replacement of Defective Items: If any component or computer is found defective and cannot be repaired within a reasonable period, the bidder shall arrange for its replacement with a new component/pr oduct of equivalent or higher specifications, without any additional cost to the purchaser. 9. OEM Warranty Certificate: The bidder shall provide the original OEM warranty certificate and ensure pro per warranty registration for all supplied computers. The warranty shall commence from the date of succe ssful installation and acceptance by the purchaser. 10. Compliance with Specifications: All supplied computers and accessories shall strictly comply with the t echnical specifications and additional specifications mentioned in the GeM bid. No deviation or substitution shall be permitted without prior written approval from the purchaser. 11. Installation and Testing: The bidder shall ensure that all computers are fully functional, properly config ured and tested before final acceptance by the purchaser. All necessary drivers, operating system configu ration and standard installation requirements shall be completed at no additional cost. 12. Acceptance of ATC: Submission of a bid shall be deemed acceptance of the above additional terms and conditions by the bidder. .
